title: Zombie bridge chase in Seoul: 7-shot Seedance 2.5 prompt
prompt_text: Cinematic live-action zombie apocalypse scene, bright sunny daytime, Seoul, South Korea. A broken Han River bridge with a huge collapsed gap, twisted rebar and cracked concrete sticking out. A young Korean schoolgirl (long dark brown hair, wearing a pink Nike dress, white knee socks, sunglasses pushed up on her head) is being chased by a huge horde of zombies across the bridge. Shot 1: Wide shot, the girl leaps mid-air across the collapsed bridge gap over the river, hair flying, zombies at the broken edge behind her. Shot 2: Close-up, she barely grabs the rusty rebar at the edge and hangs over the dark river water, a terrified, desperate face, zombie hand reaching from above. Shot 3: She pulls herself up and sprints down the bridge road, a massive zombie crowd running after her, a white sedan and a green city bus on the road, Seoul apartment skyline in the background. Shot 4: She climbs onto the roof of the green bus while zombies pack the windows and reach out with their arms. Shot 5: Extreme close-up of her shocked, wide-eyed face, wind blowing her hair. Shot 6: She jumps across the tilted bus and wrecked cars at the second broken section, the zombie horde charging behind. Shot 7: Final dramatic leap over the river gap, two men reaching out from the edge, with a black military Black Hawk helicopter hovering at the bridge pier with a rescue rope hanging down. Style: photorealistic, high-octane action, handheld dynamic camera, slow-motion jumps, dramatic wide-angle and low-angle shots, realistic motion blur, sharp detail, cinematic color grading, blockbuster zombie movie look (Train to Busan style), 4K. Negative: cartoon, anime, blurry, distorted faces, extra limbs, text, watermark, low quality. Settings: 16:9, 20 seconds, Seedance 2.5.
